sources.title: Defining service classes and performance goals
How CICS runs transactions, tasks, and programs

capabilities.version_scope: z/VM 7.3 documentation; exact installed model unknown
capabilities.original_contract: Shared partition CPU entitlement depends on weights and the shared physical CPU pool.
capabilities.semantic_gap: A container CPU limit is not PR/SM topology or entitlement equivalence.
capabilities.failure_control: Overcommit competing workloads; reject a p99 breach hidden by aggregate throughput.
capabilities.test_oracle: Competing workloads meet separate service goals under constrained CPU.

capabilities.version_scope: Basic-skills architectural description; model limits not inferred
capabilities.original_contract: The channel subsystem performs I/O asynchronously relative to central-processor work.
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Measured storage paths, queues and durability
capabilities.semantic_gap: Language async does not recreate the channel fabric or storage failure behavior.
capabilities.failure_control: Saturate the log path; reject a CPU-only capacity conclusion.
capabilities.test_oracle: Measure complete request-to-durable-commit latency with slow storage.

capabilities.original_contract: Real-storage shortage can cause paging or postponement of work according to importance.
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Process/host isolation and measured working set
capabilities.semantic_gap: Virtual address range is not resident RAM or a latency guarantee.
capabilities.failure_control: Use a dataset larger than the warm working set; reject warm-cache extrapolation.
capabilities.test_oracle: Observe working set, page activity and latency under memory pressure.

capabilities.original_contract: Service-class goals and importance participate in workload resource management.
capabilities.candidate_application: Admission control and separate workload budgets
capabilities.semantic_gap: A priority queue alone does not implement WLM policy across CPU, storage and subsystems.
capabilities.failure_control: Let batch consume the shared pool; reject an interactive deadline breach.
capabilities.test_oracle: Mixed online/batch workload meets separately declared deadlines and tails.

capabilities.version_scope: z/OS 3.1.0 documentation; model and eligibility unknown
capabilities.original_contract: zIIPs execute work marked eligible; processing-unit roles must be distinguished.
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Measured hardware placement and licensing inventory
capabilities.semantic_gap: Engine count cannot be converted into general-purpose vCPUs by a fixed factor.
capabilities.failure_control: Change eligible workload mix; reject a fixed engine-to-vCPU conversion.
capabilities.test_oracle: Replay the same mix with equivalent persistence and security, measuring useful commits.

capabilities.original_contract: A task can contain several units of work separated by SYNCPOINT.
capabilities.candidate_application: Explicit transaction boundary and idempotent recovery
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Compatible recoverable resource coordination or approved redesign
capabilities.semantic_gap: A task, browser session and SQL transaction need not share one recovery boundary.
capabilities.failure_control: Commit one participant then fail another; reject assumed global rollback.
capabilities.test_oracle: Identify each recoverable participant and reconcile failures around every syncpoint.

capabilities.version_scope: Db2 13 documentation; package/subsystem options require inventory
capabilities.original_contract: Isolation and locking options affect which concurrent changes a reader can observe.
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Target-engine isolation and constraints tested with concurrent histories
capabilities.semantic_gap: Matching isolation names does not establish matching predicate, cursor or lock behavior.
capabilities.failure_control: Run competing predicate updates; reject a final-state-only equivalence claim.
capabilities.test_oracle: Concurrent histories preserve the business predicate, including phantom/write-skew cases.

capabilities.version_scope: Db2 for z/OS 13 documentation; installed topology unknown
capabilities.original_contract: A Db2 data sharing group runs in an IBM Z Parallel Sysplex environment.
capabilities.candidate_application: One explicit write authority per domain
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Retain sharing or choose a separately tested target consistency architecture
capabilities.semantic_gap: Independent writable database replicas are not a Db2 data sharing group.
capabilities.failure_control: Allow a stale writer after failover; reject divergent accepted financial effects.
capabilities.test_oracle: Partition/rejoin tests preserve ownership, acknowledged effects and declared RPO/RTO.

capabilities.original_contract: SINGLEABORT requires INDEPENDENTTRANS; the application/end user remains responsible for rectifying the aborted transaction.
capabilities.candidate_application: Bounded full-transaction retry and durable decision identity
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Target transaction engine and recovery runbook
capabilities.semantic_gap: Do not import CICS syncpoint semantics or assume every MCP database has this option.
capabilities.failure_control: Retry only the final statement; reject missing earlier transaction effects.
capabilities.test_oracle: Force a deadlock and reconcile one aborted instruction, retry and unaffected work.

capabilities.original_contract: Reconnect-on-send-error can resend on a new connection; stateful sessions require separate consideration.
capabilities.candidate_application: Session-aware adapter and durable operation identity
capabilities.candidate_infrastructure_data: Retained CITA/TIP route or separately validated replacement
capabilities.semantic_gap: Connector reconnect is not proof of business idempotency or successful rollback.
capabilities.failure_control: Replay a stateful command on a new connection; reject duplicate or wrong-session execution.
capabilities.test_oracle: Lose a reply and reconnect; verify session context and a single accepted effect.
